Physical therapy and rehabilitation aims to restore movement and function, reduce pain and improve mobility after injury, illness or surgery. The department offers assessment, treatment and rehabilitation for a wide range of conditions, from musculoskeletal disorders to neurological diseases, along with several specialised programmes. MedLuxLife can arrange a rehabilitation stay at our partner hospital and coordinate it with your other treatment.

Treatments and services

Musculoskeletal conditions

Treatment for arthritis, osteoporosis, inflammatory and soft tissue rheumatic diseases, and neck, back and lower back pain.

Orthopaedic rehabilitation

Rehabilitation after fractures and dislocations, sports injuries, spinal curvatures, foot problems and orthopaedic surgery such as joint replacement.

Neurological rehabilitation

Programmes for stroke, brain and spinal cord injury, facial paralysis, nerve injuries, muscle diseases and Parkinson's disease.

Paediatric rehabilitation

Therapy for children with spasticity, aimed at improving movement and daily function.

Cardiac rehabilitation

Supervised exercise and recovery programmes following heart problems.

Pelvic floor and pregnancy programmes

A stress incontinence programme for urinary leakage and guided exercise during pregnancy.

Back school and osteoporosis school

Educational programmes teaching posture, movement and exercise to protect the spine and bones.

Fibromyalgia group programme

Group-based therapy and education for people living with fibromyalgia.

Specialised rehabilitation

Rehabilitation after cosmetic surgery, programmes for dialysis patients, and assessment and planning after obesity surgery.

Treatment for localised sweating

Therapy options for excessive sweating in specific areas of the body.

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Surgical or discharge reports from recent operations
  • Recent X-ray or MRI reports

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Tell us your wishes – we answer your questions, explain the options and arrange an online consultation with a specialist in Türkiye. Medical documents go directly to the doctor, only on request.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.
